brand.name: Onward Scout
brand.promise: No typing, no searching, no form-filling. You only look and tap at the moments that matter.

meta.defaultTitle: Onward Scout — Your scout for every opportunity
meta.description: Drop in your résumé, deck or portfolio. Onward Scout finds real opportunities you can win — jobs, grants, accelerators, fellowships, competitions and more — prepares each application from your own facts, submits it after your tap and follows up.
meta.ogAlt: Onward Scout — your scout for every opportunity.

audiences.studentsBlurb: Internships, scholarships, competitions and first jobs.
audiences.professionalsBlurb: Better roles, certifications, speaking slots and awards.
audiences.foundersBlurb: Investors, accelerators, grants, pitch competitions and fairs.
audiences.researchersBlurb: Calls for papers, research grants, fellowships and positions.
audiences.creatorsBlurb: Clients, brand deals, residencies, open calls and grants.
audiences.careerChangersBlurb: Bridge roles, retraining programmes and the first yes in a new field.

footer.about: Onward Scout turns what you already have into a sourced profile, finds real opportunities you can win and prepares every application — then submits it only after your tap.
footer.replyTime: We reply to every message within two business days.
footer.honesty: Nothing is submitted without your tap. CAPTCHAs, logins, payments, signatures and interviews stay with you — we hand them over as a 30-second step, never hide them.

language.label: Language
language.englishOnlyNote: This page is in English only. Choosing Chinese opens the Chinese home page.

errors.forbidden: You don’t have access to this.

errors.pageBody: The error has been logged and we will look at it. Nothing was submitted or charged because of it.

notFound.title: This path doesn’t lead anywhere.
notFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped. Your board, the opportunities and the pricing are all one tap away.

auth.metaDescription: Sign in to Onward Scout or create your account with one email code. No password, no separate sign-up.
auth.eyebrow: Sign in or create your account
auth.title: Enter your email. Get a code. You’re in.
auth.lede: One step for everyone: no password, no separate sign-up. A new email creates your account in the same step.
auth.point1Body: A résumé, a deck, a portfolio or a few links. We build your profile from them, every fact linked to its source.
auth.point2Body: Real opportunities you can win, each with why it fits, the deadline and what it asks for.
auth.point3Title: Nothing goes out without your tap
auth.point3Body: We prepare everything and submit only after you confirm. CAPTCHAs, logins and payments stay with you.
auth.free: Your profile, matching and previews are free.
auth.legal: By continuing you agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>. Codes come from Clerk, our sign-in provider; we never see or store a password.
auth.failedBody: Our sign-in provider could not be reached. Check your connection, then try again.

consent.optInDetail: It records page activity, including text you type into forms and files you upload. Cookies needed for sign-in and checkout are always on.
consent.noticeDetail: It records page activity, including text you type into forms and files you upload. You can opt out at any time.
